## Roscoe Village boards ask us first.

### Does CenterPoint manage associations in Roscoe Village?
Yes. CenterPoint Association Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Roscoe Village, Chicago (ZIP 60618, 60657). Every association gets a dedicated manager, monthly financial reporting, and board support grounded in Illinois association law.

### How much does association management cost in Roscoe Village?
Management starts at $20 per unit per month, quoted as a flat monthly fee based on your association's size, building systems, financial complexity, and service scope. It is never a percentage of your budget. See [pricing](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/pricing) for what drives the fee.

### How does a Roscoe Village association switch to CenterPoint?
Plan on a managed 30 to 60 day transition after your board gives notice under its current contract. We retrieve records from the outgoing manager, set up banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open board and resident access. Call [773.728.0652](tel:+17737280652) or [](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/request-a-proposal).

### How should a Roscoe Village board compare management companies?
Compare at least three firms on the same terms: an active Illinois community association management firm license, a licensed manager, a flat monthly fee in writing, after-hours emergency coverage, and a written transition plan. Our free [proposal scorecard](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/tools/compare-management-proposals) helps boards score proposals side by side.
